paper_conclusion: GI-TBC retains the accepted shared inventory/service representation, pair-only resource strengthening, complete own startup and Gini-interval coverage. On the twelve-input current breadth panel it certifies 9/12, versus P 7/12 and PS 7/12; the independent positive-resource panel certifies4/8, versus P 0/8 and PS 0/8. Substantive comparator reversals, opposing primal/dual endpoints, finite AM/Seed exposure and any open positive-objective 35-station results delimit the conclusion. The bounded conditional mechanism results include reversals of all three K-15-S deletion-time directions in the preselected second Seed; they do not justify per-instance settings, additive speed-up attribution or a new default. We retain tau=.08 and AP off. The next study should target an actual positive-objective bottleneck and the established integer-stock/original-epigraph gap, rather than purchase a generic stability grid or relabel previous negative candidates.
